blind.table_distance_name: open treasure chest overflowing with gold
blind.description: A stylised, fantasy-themed open wooden treasure chest heavily laden with treasure. The chest has rich brown wooden planks reinforced with chunky gold metal corner brackets, bands with rivets, and a front keyhole plate, resting on four small rounded golden feet. The hinged curved lid is propped open. Inside, a mounded pile of gold coins spills over the front edge, adorned with a golden crown studded with red gems, two tilted golden goblets, and scattered faceted red and green gemstones. All geometry is solid, smooth, and clean with a stylised hand-painted look.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears roughly rectangular: the open lid forms a curved horizontal section with three golden bands across brown wood at the top, while the lower section reveals a dense golden pile of coins featuring a crown, two golden cups, and scattered red and green gems, flanked by golden corner brackets.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.3 feet tall (around 40% the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 2.5 feet wide.
